title: Exploratory testing charter and session
when: The user wants unscripted testing that finds bugs a plan would miss, timeboxed and documented.
prompt:
Goal: One or more 30 to 45 minute charters, each with a mission, running notes, bugs and open questions.
Steps:
1. Write the charter: Explore <area> with <technique> to discover <risk> (Explore the cart with odd quantities to discover pricing errors).
2. Pick heuristics: create, read, update and delete every object; interrupt (reload, back, close midway); boundaries; many and none; personas (hurried, novice, malicious).
3. Timebox the session and keep notes with timestamps: what you tried and what you saw.
4. Log bugs at once with steps; log questions (is this intended?) separately.
5. Close with coverage: areas touched, areas not touched, ideas for the next charter.
6. Turn repeatable findings into regression items.
Quality bar:
- Charter small enough for one session.
- Notes let someone retrace the session.
- Bugs and questions kept apart.
Pitfalls:
- Random clicking with no mission.
- Writing notes only at the end.
- Reporting bugs but losing the coverage picture.
Verify:
- [ ] Charter sentence present.
- [ ] Timestamped notes exist.
- [ ] Bugs have steps.
- [ ] Coverage and next ideas written.
Output: explore-<area>.md with Charter, Notes, Bugs, Questions and Coverage sections.

examples.input: explore the booking calendar and try to break it
examples.output: charter on overlapping bookings, 40 min, 3 bugs (double booking at midnight), 2 questions, next: cancellations
